name: Communication
description: Lets the user exchange messages with a specific creature or entity across a distance they otherwise couldn't reach.

mechanics.text: On activation, the user can send and/or receive messages with a specific creature, entity, or group of linked creatures beyond normal speech range — mentally, telepathically, or otherwise. Distinct from feat.comprehend-language (understanding a language you otherwise couldn't) and feat.detection (sensing something's presence/direction).
